title: Enterprise Support: Missing primary export hours for missing-spend recognition
content:
Enterprise Support — Missing primary export hours for missing-spend recognition.

## Decision basis

For missing-spend recognition: Sum completed primary support spending export quantity in vCPU-hours for the selected original charge and period; rejected exports and supplemental baseline exports are excluded.

## Hypothetical case

For missing-spend recognition: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.
